C0446.title: 800,000 Jin of Eggs Vanished Over 4 Years: A Theft Case Exposes Blind Spots in Fundamental Analysis
C0446.summary: Six employees of Hunan Xiangjia Animal Husbandry misappropriated over 800,000 jin of company eggs over nearly four years by altering outbound shipment quantities and falsifying data, involving over 4 million yuan. The stolen eggs remained listed as 'in stock' in ledgers, causing the company's publicly reported inventory data to be persistently inflated and seriously misleading market supply-demand

references.title: Shimen County Court Sentences Six in Egg Embezzlement Case
